Improvements Description and Analysis

The subject is an existing 250-slip marina with 5 commercial buildings containing a mixture of retail and office space types. The buildings contain 48,661 square feet of rentable area and were constructed in multiple stages; with the majority of the construction completed in 1993. The commercial space is 85% leased as of the effective appraisal date. The marina docks were constructed
in multiple phases between 1991-1995 and are 52.8% occupied as of the effective appraisal date. The total site area is 2.76 acres or 120,226 square feet, which includes 0.64 acre or 27,878 square feet, that is re-claimed land. The property also includes 3.2 acres of seabed under the marina dock structures which is leased to the property owner from the Government of the Virgin Islands.
